plan.notes: Professional-phase sequence transcribed verbatim from the official Golden West College 2026-2027 catalog 'LVN to RN, Associate in Science Degree' page (Banner Code 2_AS_LVN2, Control Number 11439). Pre-Requisites (27 units, must be completed before program entry; listed in external_prereqs): ENGL C1000 (4-6) or ENGL C1000E, BIOL G220 (4), BIOL G225 (4), BIOL G210 (5), COMM C1000 (3), PSYC G118 (3), NURS G190 LVN to RN Transition (4). Professional sequence: Semester 1: NURS G175 Women's Health and Newborn Nursing (2), NURS G175C Women's Health and Newborn Nursing Clinical Practicum (2), NURS G285 Pediatric Nursing (2), NURS G285C Pediatric Nursing Clinical Practicum (1.5) = 7.5; Semester 2: NURS G271 Professional Nursing 2 (1), NURS G290 Advanced Medical Surgical Nursing (3), NURS G290C Advanced Medical Surgical Nursing Clinical Practicum (5) = 9. Professional total = 16.5. Source: https://catalog.cccd.edu/golden-west/pathways/health-sciences/nursing/nursing-lvn-rn-as/nursing-lvn-rn-as.pdf Nursing Graduation Requirements (ENGL G110, STAT C1000 or PSYC G140, SOC G111 or SOC G133 or SOC G134) may be completed prior to or during the nursing program per the catalog and are not sequenced; the catalog states Major Total 54.5 / GE Pattern 24-34 / Total Units 60. Per-slot prerequisites are not published on the program page; the published semester order is the authoritative progression, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty.
